candidates.title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment with Dynamic Rubrics for Long-Horizon Agent Training
credibilityEvidence: Section 4.1: four-way ablation (DRACO w/o Dyn. & Cred., w/o Dyn., w/o Cred., full DRACO), all sharing single pre-committed hyperparameter config
Table 2: two base models (Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct), two benchmarks (AppWorld TN/TC, τ-bench Banking zero-shot), consistency metrics pass^k over n=3 runs
Section 4.1.2: full hyperparameters (Appendix D Table 10), all judge prompts (Appendix F), code at github.com/IBM/draco
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: Four-way ablation, two models, two benchmarks (one zero-shot), consistency metrics, released code
reproducibilityEvidence: Appendix F: all judge and agent prompts
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: Ablations cleanly isolate dynamic rubrics (+3.2) and step credit (+2.4); zero-shot transfer corroborates; code public
candidates.primaryLimitation: Training depends on GPT-5.4 judge; self-judge variant drops ~4 points, limiting open-source self-sufficiency
candidates.presentationReason: Method section has closed-form credit formula, ablation table is clean, training/eval protocol explicitly avoids checkpoint selection by held-out performance
candidates.citationVelocity: Published 3 days ago; Semantic Scholar API rate-limited, no data
candidates.reason: Strongest candidate by evidence quality + practical impact: first closed-form credit assignment for outcome-blind agent RL that beats ground-truth-reward training, with full artifacts

candidates.title: CURA: Certified Runtime Alarms for Computer-Use Agents
credibilityEvidence: Abstract: 361 OSWorld tasks, ~9,100 calls, concrete CUSUM numbers (42.3% recall at α=0.10, median 31 steps early, realized FPR 0.066)
Abstract: retrospective AUROC 0.828 with fold-internal floor 0.802; explicitly reports that margin over total-token baseline is NOT significant (Δ=+0.026, p=0.101)
Abstract: reports where behavioral monitoring is uninformative (honest about failure boundaries)
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: Covers online detection, retrospective analysis, hybrid cascade, and failure boundaries; concrete numbers with statistical guarantees
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: Mathematical guarantees (CUSUM FPR control) + real benchmark validation; authors honestly report method limitations
candidates.primaryLimitation: Only catches 42.3% of failures; 57.7% slip through undetected
candidates.presentationReason: Concrete numbers in abstract, explicit statistical significance reporting, honest about limitations
candidates.citationVelocity: Published 9 days ago; Semantic Scholar API rate-limited
candidates.reason: Layer C lookback candidate (watch from 09-01, originally held for thematic diversity). Despite 5-day decay, evidence strength and unique angle (runtime monitoring with zero LLM calls) justify selection alongside DRACO and Clean Engineering for today's infrastructure-gaps theme

candidates.title: Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: A Preregistered Reliability Failure of Black-Box LLM Observers on Shared Endpoints
credibilityEvidence: Section 2: positions contribution precisely via Table 1 (what's established vs what's new)
Abstract: dual preregistered campaigns, 52,988 audited requests, byte-level identity enforced
Abstract: mechanism decomposition into 3 sources (label-meaning bias, noise-floor gap, platform nondeterminism), 4-provider cross-validation
Abstract: preregistered thresholds enforced to terminal negative verdict (both campaigns failed their gates)
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: Preregistered with enforced gates, large-N audit, mechanism decomposition, prospective follow-up experiments across 5 additional days and 4 providers
reproducibilityEvidence: Design rules and reporting checklist in paper
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: Preregistration enforced, byte-level audit makes every claim traceable, mechanism decomposition is testable
candidates.primaryLimitation: Only tests shared endpoints; self-hosted batch-invariant kernels help but 'only while the server was quiet'
candidates.presentationReason: Table 1 precisely delineates prior work vs contribution; explicit about what IS and ISN'T claimed; measurement science vocabulary used correctly
candidates.citationVelocity: Published 3 days ago; Semantic Scholar: 0 citations
candidates.reason: Completes today's infrastructure-gaps theme by exposing that the LLM-judge instrument underlying training (DRACO) and evaluation is itself unstable. Unique preregistered negative-result methodology with immediate practical implications (2% pilot calibration)

candidates.title: The Civilization Framework: Sovereign-Anchored Communication Between Personal Multi-Agent Systems
